title: (319/100) exp(-361) is not strictly below 2^{-532} (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- The degree-419 remainder envelope of `exp(361)` is strictly below `2^{532}*(319/100)`, so `(319/100) exp(-361)` is not strictly below `2^{-532}`. No partial sum of `exp(361)` exceeds that target. The section error remains below the looser majorant; this package does not raise it above `2^{-532}`. No new kappa is claimed. `Q` is not formed. No larger `C` is left open. The exact rationals are in the package verifier.
- The immediate predecessor pull request is #4400. The branch also contains the earlier open two-power packages back through #4367. This pull request adds `research/gaussian-origin-two-power-c28`.
